caps.note: GLOBAL_MAX bounds a single position, not the pool. deposit() does not check it. Because STARTER_CAP + 2 * lifetimeRevenue exceeds it, GLOBAL_MAX binds every advance here.

loans.note: Exercised on this splitter: 5.00 advance, 18.00 revenue, 5.40 repaid, 12.60 to agent, surplus 0.

admin.purpose: deposit, withdraw free funds, pause, register splitters
admin.note: Deployer only. Holds the vault DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE so a lost agent key is recoverable. Not used for payment signing.

agent.purpose: owns the splitter, withdraws its revenue, administers its own contract
agent.note: Holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and AGENT_ROLE on its own splitter, so a lost key is recoverable and payout can be redirected. Agent and payout are the same address here for simplicity; splitting them only changes payout(), never authority.

settler.purpose: signs EIP-3009 payments in the hosted seller; holds a small float

notes: Everything here is Arc TESTNET. The contracts do not exist on Arc mainnet.
The splitter is a minimal proxy clone of splitterImpl, deployed by the factory.
Third deployment. Splitter 0xe788d455 was created for an agent key that was then lost, leaving its 12.60 claimable stranded; it is superseded and abandoned.
Each role uses a distinct key. Only the deployer administers the vault; the agent administers its own splitter.
